prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square premium naturalistic painterly Mythics illustration of GABRIEL, respectful sacred angel, monumental divine messenger of solemn benevolent authority. Select specifically the accepted JEWISH iconographic tradition: the form of a MAN CLOTHED IN LINEN, with WINGS, and the documented PRINCE OF FIRE association. One human head, TWO natural eyes, exactly TWO human arms, TWO human legs and ONE PAIR of large wings, all anatomically coherent. This single pair is an illustrative arrangement where this tradition does not state a wing count; do NOT combine the Islamic six-hundred-wing variant. Gabriel is descending in swift flight, wings spread broadly through upper corners, both empty hands open in a clear dignified messenger gesture. Fully opaque long ivory linen robe with long sleeves, high closed neckline, several dense layers of cloth over chest, waist and legs; fabric hangs with flight and feet emerge modestly below. No weapons or trumpet or scroll. A powerful crownless noble face, calm readable expression; luminous warm firelight across his untouched linen. Below and behind the hovering figure, enormous golden-orange FLAMES rise in elegant physically fiery plumes, illustrating his documented fire association, NOT burning his body or garments; no victims or destruction. Extreme low-angle upward view from a small rocky landscape beneath him, tiny distant hills for scale, evening sky and sculptural clouds. Huge awe-inspiring wings and fire-lit figure dominate the square rather than an ordinary person portrait. Naturalistic painterly feather/linen textures, cinematic gold against deep blue dusk, radiant respectful beauty and original silhouette. Flight and fire are source-supported; scene, two-wing arrangement and feather materials are artistic visualization. No extra heads/eyes/arms/legs/wings, no lightning, magic beams or energy ribbons, no nakedness, transparency, gore, text, inscriptions, border, logo or watermark. Entirely original, no movie, game, anime, comic or existing painting imitation.
